reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works well enough. Handwritten nota from the building-supply shop are a pain, but not bad enough to add a second tool and a separate Google Sheet next to what we already have.
objection: It's a small Telegram bot. If it shuts down in a year, my records are split between two systems and I'd have to retrain everyone on something else.
would_change_my_mind: If it exported straight into Jurnal or Zoho so my bookkeeper doesn't have to touch a second sheet, and I could see it has been running for a while with real Bali businesses using it.
